name: retro-arcade
description: Five standalone browser games in one static arcade.

scripts.test: npm run test:site && npm run test:games
scripts.test:games: npm --prefix games/pong test && npm --prefix games/frogger test && npm --prefix games/space-invaders test && npm --prefix games/asteroids test && npm --prefix games/snake test
scripts.check: node --check games/pong/app.js && node --check games/pong/game.js && node --check games/frogger/main.js && node --check games/frogger/game.js && node --check games/space-invaders/app.mjs && node --check games/space-invaders/game.mjs && npm --prefix games/asteroids run check && npm --prefix games/snake run check
